notes.title: Finally release, leaving Early Access!
notes.notes:
Early Access no more!!!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300230/47a9584982c95097f1ba19e427e0192fe232bb34.png"]

New planet (Mountain level), stranded in the mountains you need to climb to find better materials. Someone has been on the planet before you. Cna that help you survive?

Two new monster types dwell in the mountains, watch out for the during the night!

Day and Night cycle will be faster on this planet, make sure you calculate the time efficiently.

New game mode (trigger), trigger the night of endless waves of monsters when you feel ready. Test your building skills and defenses. What will work best?
